chapter_title: Concerning the Five Releases: what they are
chapter_note: Dominantly a systematic cosmological list of five "releases" (rescues/redemptions) tied to named cosmic agents (First Man, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Splendour, Great Counsel/Summons-Obedience), with heavy lacunose transmission. The main late accretion is the final eschatological-institutional paragraph about "apostles," "commandment," and judgment (¶12), plus a brief exhortative beatitude (¶13). ¶1 contains a hagiographic speech-introduction framing the core list; ¶6 contains an institutional seam (“churches”) embedded within an otherwise cosmological description of Jesus the Splendour’s saving work.

paragraphs.core_text: [There are] five [releases by] which the light is saved f[rom] all [the rulers and] powers of darkness!
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed hagiographic/frame attribution introducing speech: "[Once again] our father [s]peaks:" (dialogue/frame layer). Also excluded manuscript page marker ⟨p.60⟩.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Frame formula (“Once again… speaks”) wraps a compact cosmological thesis-statement; the teaching itself is impersonal/systematic (five-fold structure).

paragraphs.core_text: [The first loo]sening and saving is that of [the] First Man, since when the First M[a]n was freed fro[m the prison of] the rulers by the Living Spirit, who had come [... ...] of the First Man, much light and [much] power was saved from the entire ruling-power. They ascended with the First Man to the aeons [of] greatn[ess]. This [is the first] release.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic first item in a numbered five-fold cosmological sequence; cosmos→cosmos rescue-mechanics with named aeonic beings.

paragraphs.core_text: The second saving is that of the Liv[ing] Spirit, since whe[n] the Father of Life and [the] Mother of [Li]fe constructed [the ... ...] and [w]orlds [... wo]rlds, the earths and their [rulers; im]measurable light was saved f[r]om them [... the First] Man, who w[a]s devoured [...] lig[ht ...
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the enumerated cosmological process (construction of worlds/earths/rulers; saving of light) without institutional address or citation.

paragraphs.core_text: ... ... th]ree wars [... ...] to the time when he [... ...] above [...] them upon the [... ...] universe.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Though highly lacunose, it reads as internal continuation of the preceding cosmological sequence (wars/universe), not as church discipline or citation.

paragraphs.core_text: [The third red]emption is that of the Thi[rd Ambassador ... he] displayed [his image ...] he [... ... the r]uling-power; he [... ... ... ...] from them [... ...] So this is [how] the [...] his image that [...] in the Th[ir]d Ambassador.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third item in the five-fold series; correspondential/cosmological language (“image,” “ruling-power”) remains within mythic mechanics.

paragraphs.core_text: [Th]e fourth s[av]ing is that of Jesus the Splendour, since whe[n he was] re[ve]aled in the zone he displayed [his im]age in front of the firmaments and purified [the light] that is above. He took the likeness [...] he made himself like the angels in [...] un[til] he travelled and descended to the form of flesh. He set in order [t]he earths and all the fastenings. He also loosen[ed ...] light without measure in the entire structure. He gave [the] summons and the obedience to the elements, he formed [J]esus the Youth. He as[ce]n[d]ed and rested himself in the light [land].
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed institutional clause identifying an ecclesial referent: "He established the first righteous o[ne ...] all the churches." This crosses from cosmic mechanism to contemporary/institutional pointing.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core mythic description of an aeonic agent (Jesus the Splendour) operating across zones/firmaments/elements is interrupted by an explicit institutional referent (“churches”), indicating a later application seam embedded in the paragraph.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth release and saving is that of the great counsel, w[hich is the s]umm[ons an]d the obedience, since it also [...] the soul from the [land] of greatness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the five-fold list in cosmological terms (Great Counsel/Summons-Obedience; soul; land of greatness) without institutional regulation.

paragraphs.core_text:
[...] the Living Spirit [...] as he gave [...] the release [... ...]
The first [... ... he] ascended and he [... ...] as he [... ...] wisdom [... ...]
The fourth [... ...] its wisdom [...]
And also, the fifth [... ...] into it, and it sets it in order [...] its light image in this Last Statue.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Internal recapitulation/structural linking of the releases (first/fourth/fifth) and the Last Statue within the cosmic system.

paragraphs.core_text: These five grea[t] powe[rs ...] were revealed. They came to a profit [... ...] they were established upon [... ...] First Man [...] when he came to/ward [...] from the struggle. He set in order and constructed [...] universe [... ...] the First M[an ...] his advent.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Summative cosmological sequencing (five powers revealed/established; struggle; construction of universe) stays cosmos→cosmos; application-score signal is not borne out by explicit exhortation here.
Lacunose connective closure likely concluding the cosmological arrangement; no institutional or citation markers visible.

paragraphs.core_text: ... because of the light [th]at had rushed from [... ...] the Amba[s]sa[d]or.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fragment still keyed to a core cosmological figure (“Ambassador”) and the movement of light (redemption mechanics).

Institutional/disciplinary and communal authority vocabulary (“commandment,” “apostles,” “last season,” judging souls) shifts from cosmological exposition to church-eschatological administration; consistent with late editorial/pastoral layer.
Beatitude-style exhortation (“Blessed is every person… understand”) is application to the hearer rather than cosmological mapping; functions as a closing admonition, not substrate teaching.
